newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks close soft on retail selling.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks close soft on retail selling.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed lower on Wednesday as retail investors sold blue chips, but volume was thin as institutions remained on the sidelines ahead of interim results due shortly, brokers said.
The all share index closed 1.9 points down at 820. Blue chip Hayleys Ltd fell 5.75 rupees to 270, National Development Bank Ltd five to 276.

"The index eased mainly on retail selling of blue chips. Apart from a few big parcels, trading was held back due to a lack of interest on the part of sellers to come down on prices," said Buddhike Payoe of brokerage Lanka Securities.
Turnover was 70.5 million rupees, led by 903,100 shares of Asian Hotels Ltd and 385,000 Bogawantalawa Plantations Ltd.
Foreign buying amounted to 33.8 million rupees and selling, 26.5 million.
Brokers expect the all share index to remain ranged and volumes to stay thin until interim corporate results come out later this month. -- Colombo newsroom (941) 434319
